title: maint.event.v1{kind=dlq_consumer_broken}
description: Phase 8 §8.5 C2 — notification emitted by maint.dlq.v1 when the poison-pattern detector fires: ≥ cfg.maint_dlq_poison_distinct_threshold distinct request_ids escalated on the same topic within cfg.maint_dlq_poison_window_s seconds. The supervisor freezes that topic; an operator must send `dlq_unfreeze` to resume replays. Edge-triggered: emitted once per freeze, not on every escalation while frozen.
